'''CZ-5X Eradicator Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] manufactured by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. During the [[Seizure of CZ-198]] in [[3638 BBY]] the droid was used to opposed the forces trying to establish control over [[CZ-198]], but was destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
CZ-5X Eradicator Droid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as a hostile NPC on CZ-198.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
